aboutus.banner.desc: Hindura aho utuye hamwe nigitambara cyiza cyane, aho imiterere nuburyo bwiza bihurirana muri fibre yose.
aboutus.desc: Murakaza neza kuri Al-Barkaat Rugs, aho imigenzo ihura nudushya mwisi yuzuye igorofa nziza. Ishyaka ryacu kuri tapi ryashinze imizi muri buri fibre, kandi twishimiye cyane kubagezaho uburyo bunoze bwo gutondekanya ibitambaro byiza byerekana uburanga, ihumure, nubukire bwumuco. Waba ushaka kwinjiza umwanya wawe hamwe nubushyuhe bwimigenzo gakondo, gukurura ibishushanyo mbonera bya none, cyangwa guhuza byombi, ibitambaro byacu byakozwe muburyo bwo kurenga décor gusa no kuba abaragwa bakundwa murugo rwawe cyangwa mubiro byawe. Injira mubice aho ubukorikori buhura numurage, aho ibishushanyo mbonera bidoda hamwe hamwe nuburyo bugezweho - kuvumbura itapi nziza kugirango wuzuze imiterere yawe kandi uzamure aho utuye kuri Al-Barkaat Rugs.
aboutus.service1: Kugaragaza Agaciro kadasanzwe: Inshingano zacu zishingiye kukuzamura uburambe bwawe binyuze mubiciro byapiganwa, guteza imbere ubufatanye, no gutanga serivisi ntagereranywa.
aboutus.service2: Kuzamura indashyikirwa: Urugendo rwacu rwometse ku guharanira kudacogora. Hamwe n'ubwitange bukomeye mu guhanga udushya no kwiyemeza kutajegajega kugira ngo tumenye neza ko twishimiye, turagerageza gusobanura ibipimo ngenderwaho by'inganda. Muzadusange mugihe dutangiye urugendo rugana ahazaza heza, heza.
aboutus.service3: Kwakira Ibishoboka bitagira akagero: Icyerekezo cyacu kirenze ibizenguruka mugihe twakira buri munsi twuzuye amahirwe mashya yo gukura no kwihindagurika. Twiyeguriye ejo hazaza hashyizweho udushya, iterambere, hamwe nubushobozi butagira umupaka, turagutumiye kwifatanya natwe mugutegura inkuru z'ejo.
aboutus.service4: Gukora Agaciro, Kwemeza Kuba indashyikirwa: Twishimiye cyane ibyo twiyemeje kuguha bimwe mubiciro byapiganwa mu nganda. Gukurikirana ubudacogora gushakisha ikiguzi-cyiza no gushakisha ingamba bidufasha kwagura amafaranga menshi kuri wewe. Twizera tudashidikanya ko ubushobozi butagomba na rimwe guhungabanya ireme rya serivisi cyangwa ibicuruzwa wakiriye. Rero, dukomeza kwibanda ku kudatezuka ku gutanga agaciro ntagereranywa.
